name: Tanjoubi ni wa Kotetsu-san o Kudasai!
original_name: 誕生日には虎徹さんをください!
source: For his birthday, Barnaby only wants one thing: Kotetsu. So he kidnaps Kotetsu and brings him to his apartment...
translation: For his birthday, Barnaby only wants one thing: Kotetsu. So he kidnaps Kotetsu and brings him to his apartment...
